name: Bear Trapper All-Day Homestyle Pancakes, Eggs & Ham/Swiss Omelet
brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Bear Trapper serves breakfast all day—fluffy white-flour pancakes, scrambled eggs, or a diced ham and aged Swiss/cheddar omelet provide gentle, low-residue protein and carbs anytime.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the plain Homestyle Pancakes with scrambled eggs or a Ham & Cheese Omelet (skip raw bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms in the Denver/Western omelet).
watchOuts: Skip hash browns if heavily browned in griddle oil
